body:
~~Still unsure of why this is happening only with the router. I tried [creating a version replicating what the router](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#) does but I still couldn't find it~~. I also noticed, the problem appears with flat routes too.

Any help on this one is welcome!

@posva 
if  change the `<style scoped>`  to ` <style>` , it works fine. see https://codesandbox.io/s/white-river-3mf6q
here is no `scopedId`
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3705199/147827847-ffbefca7-1529-46dc-be24-9b1bf02297cd.png)

Thanks @edison1105 

~~Still [works on SFC Playground](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#) 🤔~~ I think I got confused between working or not working, it does [not work without vue router indeed](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#) and removing scoped seems to be a workaround.

@posva 
I found something. Maybe this is not the right fix. Just a hint here.
- `currentScopeId` is null when `createVNode` from `TopLevelAwait.vue`  in `RouterView`.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3705199/147845364-c7474bbc-d99f-4806-85e0-b6e52e036716.png)

- when suspense resolved, we will cloned it in `_createVNode` because `Component` is a VNode. So we losed the `scopedId`
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3705199/147845625-2063dff4-3d4d-4dec-bc14-4f831a2e5b01.png)

- If we reassign the value to the scopeId when clone it will solve the problem. 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3705199/147845761-6b9ba46a-8950-4380-ae4e-1b56636e225d.png)


- **Here is a difference, in SFC Playground**. It is not a VNode, so each time `createVnode` is called, the `scopeId` is assigned the value.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3705199/147845978-e9fa8a87-e1a4-44ce-a2aa-5f6d3013160d.png)

issue.title: fix(runtime-core): ensure scopeId is correct when receiving an existing vnode

repository.name: core

issue.body:
fix #5148 
the root cause is that the `scopeId` is not attached when receiving an existing vnode.
see more https://github.com/vuejs/vue-next/issues/5148#issuecomment-1003518540

body:
@edison1105 @posva I was facing the same issue with [reusable transitions](https://vuejs.org/guide/built-ins/transition.html#reusable-transitions)  so I made up another (much simpler in my opinion) playground to better reproduce it, until I found this opened issue.

[Here's the link](https://play.vuejs.org/#__PROD__)

You can reproduce this by checking how the ``data-v-*`` attributes are missing on Suspense's inner div.

I can confirm that with #5195 I'm still having the issue (I rebased that PR into main and still the same thing).

@edison1105 Another interesting finding: [SFC link](https://play.vuejs.org/#__PROD__)

I think this issue is basically solvable if Suspense passes down $attrs, so the data-v* attribute also gets passed down.

@ferferga 
I'll take a closer look at it later.
